name: REA
description: Let your agents reverse engineer a shipped app or file with REA (morluto/rea, MIT, pinned 6.1.0): Electron/ASAR and JavaScript apps (routes, IPC), APKs, .NET assemblies, native binaries with Ghidra, archives and HAR captures. Static tools only: nothing runs the analysed target. REA is not a sandbox: its engines parse the file as you, so analyse only files you trust. Analysis results go to your agent's model provider.
